venues.name: The Queen
venues.coverage: 2025-01 to 2026-10 via Songkick gigography pages 1-4; site listings 2026-10 to 2026-12

venues.name: Jamey's House of Music
venues.coverage: site listing 2026-10-29 to 2026-11-29; Songkick scattered 2025-2026 dates

venues.name: Wilmington Brew Works

venues.name: 118 North

venues.name: 2SP Brewing Co.
venues.notes: Friday taproom music, almost all solo acoustic; only duos recorded. Near Ridley/Chester.

venues.coverage: 2025-01 to 2026-12 via County Lines Magazine monthly listings + venue site

venues.name: Arden Gild Hall

venues.name: Kelly Center for Music, Arts and Community

notes: Area: Delaware County PA (Media, Lansdowne, Havertown, Swarthmore, Aston/Ridley, Wayne edge), Chester County PA (West Chester, Kennett Square, Downingtown, Exton, Malvern/Chesterbrook, Coatesville, Oxford; Phoenixville skipped), Wilmington/Arden and Newark DE. Window 2025-01-01 to 2026-12-31. Sources: venue Events Calendar REST APIs (Wilmington Brew Works, Shere-E-Punjab, 2SP, County Lines Magazine), venue sites, Songkick gigography pages, County Lines Magazine monthly listings (source_type press), WXPN/Delaware Live articles, the Delco Parks 2026 PDF and the West Chester Porchfest 2025 PDF. Per the area brief The Queen (and The Grand) rows are local/regional acts only; that selection is my judgement from names and bills. Solo performers, open mics, jams, DJs, school/community ensembles and concert bands were left out; acoustic duos were kept. Songkick rows (source_type aggregator) are indexes of past shows, can miss bill-mates, and sometimes double-list. Wayback Machine (web.archive.org) was unreachable from this machine, so venues whose sites keep only upcoming events (Kennett Flash, Jamey's, Lansdowne Theater, Penns Woods, Victory) are thin for 2025-2026 and are good wayback.py targets. Bandsintown, DICE (Arden), Deer Park Tavern, Kennett Brewing, Levante and the Queen's event pages were blocked. Not found or unverified: 'Sellers Hall' (no such venue found in the area), 'Burning Brothers' (only a St. Paul MN brewery), Ministry of Caffeine, Gable Music Ventures' 2025-2026 shows (beyond its historical Ladybug link), Media Music Fest (only Media Borough Porch Fest found, no lineup), Upper Darby Summer Stage (youth theater, not bands) and Tower Theater (national only), Ridley taprooms other than 2SP Brewing in Aston, Iron Hill (no music calendar), Malvern/Paoli Pike bars. 2025 lineups missing: Rose Tree Summer Festival, Ladybug, Havertown Irish Festival, Turk's Head, Media Porch Fest, Rockford Park and Riverfront Wilmington series. 1984 (Wilmington): domain now serves spam. Wilmington NC results were excluded.
